source.author: cic
source.text: sed quid ego nunc haec ad te, cuius domi nascuntur ?
source.text_original: sed quid ego nunc haec ad te, cuius domi nascuntur γλαῦκ' εἰς ̓Αθήνας?
source.text_english: But why am I saying these things to you now, when they are born in your own house?

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text_english: These things are born for us at home.
